title: 短击
author: Kingdom Come Combat
first_page: 输入：上、上、左。两次上段攻击后，以左击绕过对手武器。
second_page: 短击在于突然针对头顶的打击。越短越难被读到。翻到这里，你已经开始练习短击。

en_us.title: Kurzhaw
en_us.first_page: Input: Up, Up, Left. Follow two overhead attacks with a short left strike around the opponent's weapon.
en_us.second_page: Kurzhaw is a sudden attack to the crown. The tighter the motion, the harder it is to read.
